Born in Cameroon Raised in France Based in South Florida

Comedy with
no borders.

Emmanuel Carre—better known as Call Me Manny—turns the collisions between cultures, generations, and relationships into high-energy comedy.

A former collegiate soccer player, Manny found his way to comedy after a heart condition changed the direction of his athletic career. His sketches about African dads, dating, and everyday misunderstandings have built a global online audience; now, he’s bringing those stories to the stage.
